Tilting at Windmills

In the age of LLMs, writing a blog feels futile. But... it is a great way to practice writing and share knowledge. (The italicized text is a quote from a famous author was generated by Github copilot. We'll see...)

About Me

I've been a software developer for... a while. I started out as a QA/Test engineer -- a path that I regret going down -- and have mostly done backend (Java/Python) since about 2005. I like cli tools. As a relatively old guy working as a software engineer, I still have a passion for the field. I still really enjoy coding and learning new things.

In a former life, I was an aspiring classical musician.
